services.name: Helicopter Ice Hiking
services.desc: This trip is designed for those visiting Seward, Alaska who either want a private Ice Climbing tour, or want to up the ante set by our other climbing trips with more difficulty, further remoteness (via helicopter), longer exploration, pushing the limits, etc. I could go on and on. This tour is by far the guide favorite as the climbs we are able to access with the helicopter take glacier Ice Climbing to a new level. Experience fathomless moulins that echo. Climb beside waterfalls plunging into the unknown void. Or be content to climb at a moderate level in a completely remote and breathtaking environment customized for you. The tour starts in the Seward airport where we load the helicopter.

blurb: Exit Glacier Guides offers guided hikes on glaciers and alpine areas around Seward, Alaska, including helicopter-accessed glacier hikes. They emphasize safety with a dedicated guide training program and have been operating since 2004. Their adventures include glacier hiking, mountaineering clinics, and alpine hiking trips.
